about: Every EDUCMS-SHIM-V6 body ever baked into a kept AI board, byte for byte, recovered from apps/api/src/ai/designer-edit-shim.ts at the commit that shipped it. Saved boards still carry these; buildSafeDesignerSrcdoc swaps each one for its EDUCMS-SHIM-V7 at render. Each sha256 is the value pinned in apps/web/src/lib/designer-safe-srcdoc.ts TRUSTED_RUNTIMES. Test data only — never edit.
